quotes.text: // three tests for Graph once we support updates on sync.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The newly enabled Graph task runs the batching helper with 10 generated messages and a four-item mock page limit. It checks created count, no deletions, Message-Id and Subject values and a recorded token after the listener completes. The other three shared scenarios remain EWS-only in this historical phase, and the mock does not handle updates. Accepted task registration enables later Graph scenarios. These are direct source assertions, not an executed result or coverage of every returned header/property. The reused EWS helper also compares deleted-ID count with an updated-ID array length; that assertion does not identify the updated items.
title: The initial Graph sync test covers create pagination while deferring update scenarios
